execution_condition: runs ONLY if the primary discovery satisfies ALL critical gates; if the primary fails, none of these analyses may be run, reported as leads, or used to justify a retest
primary_parameters_immutable: the primary hypothesis parameters (60d funding lookback, min 90 obs, median/1.4826*MAD, thresholds +/-2.0, strict 24h OI expansion, NONE price context, next-bar-open entry, 72h hold, 10 bps primary cost, 3 assets) are immutable; robustness results can only qualify or falsify the frozen claim, never redefine it

robustness_analyses.definition: chronological halves, thirds and quartiles of the common window; plus a 3-fold expanding walk-forward (evaluate fold k using only decisions before fold k's start for any threshold-free bookkeeping; all signal parameters stay frozen)
robustness_analyses.reporting: net expectancy, PF and N per split
robustness_analyses.requirement: no requirement relaxes the primary gates; any split that is uniformly negative is reported as an explicit instability

robustness_analyses.definition: per-asset results and all leave-one-asset-out pooled results
robustness_analyses.reporting: N, net expectancy, PF, ex-funding expectancy
robustness_analyses.requirement: the pooled PASS must not depend entirely on a single asset

robustness_analyses.definition: frozen regime definitions computed without peeking at ARC-01 results: (a) funding-regime terciles by trailing 60d median |funding|, (b) volatility terciles by trailing 30d realized volatility of 1h log returns, (c) calendar-year splits. Tercile edges are computed once on the frozen window.
robustness_analyses.reporting: net expectancy and N per regime cell
robustness_analyses.requirement: any regime cell with N < 40 is reported as INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, never as a lead

robustness_analyses.definition: the frozen 0/10/20/40 bps scenarios, reported as a monotone cost curve with the trade set held IDENTICAL across scenarios
robustness_analyses.requirement: the curve must be monotone and the 10 bps conclusion must be reproducible from the same trade set (NET = GROSS + FUNDING_CASHFLOW - COST)

robustness_analyses.definition: one-factor-at-a-time neighbourhood of the PRIMARY parameters, evaluated for stability of the SIGN of net expectancy only: funding lookback {30d, 60d, 90d}; funding threshold {1.5, 2.0, 2.5}; OI expansion window {12h, 24h, 48h}; holding period {24h, 48h, 72h, 120h}
robustness_analyses.requirement: >= 60% of neighbourhood cells must keep a POSITIVE sign of net expectancy at 10 bps; a sign reversal in a MAJORITY of cells is reported as PARAMETER_FRAGILITY
robustness_analyses.hard_constraint: these cells are DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; the primary parameters are NOT changed, no cell may become the new primary, and the neighbour best cell must never be reported as the ARC-01 result

robustness_analyses.definition: concentration by asset, calendar month, calendar year and single trade; plus leave-one-trade-out and leave-one-month-out re-estimation
robustness_analyses.requirement: primary concentration gates must still hold after the worst single-month removal

robustness_analyses.definition: NO_SIGNAL reason-code histogram over time, and the count of decisions surviving each eligibility stage
robustness_analyses.requirement: report only; a collapse of signal density in a sub-period must be disclosed as an explicit coverage limitation

forbidden_during_robustness: re-running the primary with modified parameters
reporting any sub-cell as ARC-01's result
using robustness outcomes to reset the preregistration
output_location: docs/arc01-prereg-01/robustness/ (created only at the later authorized checkpoint)
